title: Gopherfest 2017 | Upspin with Rob Pike
summary: Rob Pike presents Upspin at Gopherfest 2017, an experimental framework for naming and sharing files and data securely and uniformly across a global namespace. It is a project written in Go rather than about Go.
why: Cited as the talk that introduced Upspin, and called fascinating and really good by commenters.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: It's a fascinating talk. I really enjoyed it.
